items.author: Strategy
items.context: Strategy ($MSTR): en el mercado bajista de 2022 su Net Reserve era negativa y un tercio de sus BTC estaba pignorado como colateral, pero sobrevivieron. Hoy dicen tener una Net Reserve de US$35.000 millones, todos sus BTC libres de gravámenes, y más convicción y opcionalidad que nunca.
items.suggested_text:
Pledged vs unencumbered is the detail most people skip, and it's the one that decides who makes it through a drawdown. In 2022 BTC fell roughly 77% from its high; coins posted as collateral in a move like that stop being an asset you hold and become a margin call someone else controls.

Past cycles put the stakes in numbers: after the 2013 peak BTC dropped 84.5% and took 1,177 days to reclaim it, and the 2011 cycle needed 622 days after a 92.7% fall. Anyone forced to sell inside those windows never saw the recovery, no matter how right they were about the long term: https://x.com/ForecastQuant/status/2122375393776951738

Unencumbered coins buy time, and time is what a bear market really tests. The harder question for any balance sheet is what happens when "temporary" lasts longer than the plan assumed.
